title: Jorgensen 2001: centroid distance of rectus abdominis at T12 (F, supine)

imaging.modality: MRI 1.5 T Philips GyroScan, spin echo T1 (TR 240, TE 12)
imaging.plane: transverse slices perpendicular to the table (scanner axial), through approximate centres of vertebral bodies T8-S1
imaging.posture_detail: supine, knees extended, hands across abdomen

quantity.name: centroid_distance
quantity.definition: distance from the vertebral-body (or disc) centroid to the muscle area centroid in the image plane; AP signed (+ anterior, - posterior), ML unsigned lateral distance. NOT a true moment arm

source.authors: Jorgensen MJ, Marras WS, Granata KP, Wiand JW
source.sample: 30 healthy subjects (20 F, 10 M); young healthy volunteers, no activity-limiting back pain

protocol.summary: Supine MRI, 10-mm T1 axial slices through vertebral body centres T8-S1; area centroids of muscles and vertebral body; distances in sagittal (AP) and coronal (ML) directions, adjusted for the angle between spinous process and vertebral body centroid; mean of three observations.
how_to_simulate: Pose the model supine (as in the MRI: lying, knees extended); use the vertebral-body centroid at mid-height of T12 as origin.
Cut a transverse plane perpendicular to the body long axis (scanner axial, NOT parallel to the endplate) through the centre of the T12 vertebral body.
For each side, take the force-weighted (PCSA or Fmax weighted) mean intersection point of all model rect. abd. paths with that plane.
Report AP (signed, + anterior of the vertebral-body centroid) and ML (unsigned) distances; compare right and left separately with the measured mean +/- SD (or average L/R for a symmetric model).
This is a centroid offset, not a moment arm; for this paper sagittal = AP, coronal = ML.

subject_model.source: Table 1 (SD: age 7.2, height 5.9, weight 6.4; trunk depth/width at iliac crest 19.8/28.0 cm, at xyphoid 18.4/27.0 cm)

protocol.notes: Authors call these "moment-arms"; they are centroid distances. Values converted cm -> mm (x10).

extraction.check_notes: Column (level) of every value confirmed on rendered pages 185-186 (layout text misaligned blank cells). Signs as printed (posterior negative).
